messages:
nina: quick sync: we need to finalise the instrumentation + replay protocol for automatic fallback. main tradeoff: capture minimally useful context vs storage/PII risk. thoughts? @omar @zack

omar: prefer a two-tier capture: 1) lightweight audit record always (policy_id, trigger, trace_id, variant), 2) full replay blob only when sampled and tenant allows. default sampling 0.1%.

zack: agree. add `fallback_score` (0-1) to audit so we can prioritise anomalous fallbacks for replay. also prefer signed short-lived URLs for blob access (7d).

infra-bot: note: current event-store schema v3 has a 1MB max for events. full replay blobs need to go to object-store and link via `blob_url` in audit record.

nina: important: what fields in lightweight audit? propose: event_type=fallback_decision; timestamp; trace_id; tenant_id; policy_id; trigger_type; matched_variant; fallback_score; sampled=false/true; fallback_id (uuid). keep it small and indexable.

omar: yep. for sampled blobs we should store: request_headers (scrubbed), request_body_fingerprint (hash), response_diff_summary, model_ids, kv_cache_snapshot_meta, and an operator_note field. never store raw user prompt unless tenant opts in with explicit agreement.

zack: legal/PII ask: we need an explicit opt-in flow and UI consent for storing request bodies. @legal any constraints?

legal: high-level: storing user-provided text is high risk. require tenant admin consent + data classification on a per-tenant basis. default: no raw-text retention. If tenant enables it, we need DLP hooks (scrubbing), retention policy UI, and a record of consent. Also mention in contract annex.

nina: good call. UX: console timeline should show counts + top triggers and allow filtering by severity/fallback_score. sampled traces show a "Replay" button that opens a gated sandbox. replay only allowed to users with `replay` permission.

omar: technical: replay should run against the "current model set" in a sandbox with isolation and input scrubbing toggles. playback job returns a reconciliation report: original behavior vs replayed output + diff score. record that as a child audit event.

zack: telemetry plumbing: sampled events get a `fallback_id` in header: `x-redwood-fallback-id: <uuid>` plus `x-redwood-fallback-sampled: 1`. SDKs surface this as `response.fallbackMeta`.

infra-bot: reminder: need API contract change. Please prepare backward-compatible header names and update swagger.

nina: decision proposal: default = lightweight audit records for all fallback decisions; sampling 0.1% for full replays; tenant opt-in for raw payload retention; replay gated by RBAC + DLP scrubber; blob URLs signed 7d. owners: omar -> event schema + pipeline; zack -> replay infra + sandbox; nina -> console UX + RFC; legal -> consent language. quick ack:

omar: ack

zack: ack

legal: ack (will send language tomorrow)

infra-bot: ticket RW-9987 created: "Fallback instrumentation + replay protocol RFC" assigned to nina, omar, zack.

nina: i'll post RFC this afternoon and include example headers + event samples.
